name: ip-legal-research
description: Retrieve the legal basis and professional-database facts that intellectual-property work depends on — supporting statutes/司法解释 and their effectiveness status, similar-case adjudication rules, and — critically — the authoritative registration/technical facts held in IP专业数据库 (patent literature, trademark registers, copyright registration, domain WHOIS, entity-credit data). Runs a multi-layer retrieval pipeline: structured IP-fact extraction, legal-issue positioning, statutory-hierarchy scanning, professional-database routing (auto-fetch vs login-required manual-query guidance), own-side/counter-side comprehensive retrieval, multi-round adaptive search, effectiveness verification, and applicability validation in a feedback loop. Every professional database from the归集表 is mapped into scenario workflows here. Tool selection is internal and never exposed to users; but login-required manual-query steps ARE shown to users so they can self-query and回填. Use whenever确权/侵权/FTO/可注册性/维权/战略 work needs statutory backing, registration facts, or prior-art/near-mark/prior-right evidence.
